title: Best AI Guest Messaging for Short-Term Rentals (2026)
summary: Akia, Conduit, Besty, Aeve, Hospitable, Duve, Enso Connect, and HostBuddy compared on PMS write-back, voice, automations, and published prices.
body_markdown:
*Written by Punn Kam, ex-Google AI engineer and Y Combinator repeat founder. He is the co-founder of Conduit, an AI agent platform built for hospitality, serving 300+ hospitality brands in 140+ languages. Last updated October 7, 2026.*


The best AI guest messaging software for short-term rentals in 2026 is Akia or Conduit if you want one agent that answers messages and calls and acts in your PMS, Besty for a cautious autopilot with an operations module, Aeve for policy-locked replies on Guesty or Hostaway, and Hospitable if you want the AI inside the PMS. Duve, Enso Connect, and HostBuddy round out the list.


## How did we rank AI guest messaging software for short-term rentals?


I ranked AI guest messaging software for short-term rentals by how far each tool can carry a guest request without a person, counting five capabilities from each vendor's own pages: AI replies across OTA and direct channels, AI that answers phone calls, actions written back to the PMS, tasks created inside the product, and a builder for procedures or event-triggered automations. Ties are alphabetical. Conduit is my company, and it sits where the count puts it.


I picked that criterion because most short-term rental questions are easy to answer and hard to finish. "Can we check out at 1pm?" takes one sentence to reply to and three systems to resolve. Every vendor fact below links the page I checked in October 2026, and anything not on the vendor's site is marked "not published".


## What are the best AI guest messaging tools for short-term rentals in 2026?


The eight AI guest messaging tools below all answer short-term rental guests with AI, and they differ most in what happens after the reply. Akia and Conduit cover all five capabilities in the ranking, Besty covers four, Aeve and Hospitable cover three, and Duve, Enso Connect, and HostBuddy cover two.


### 1. Akia (5 of 5)


Akia runs one AI agent across messages and the phone. Its[guest messaging page](https://www.akia.com/agents/guest-messaging) says Akia "answers up to 90% of guest texts and messages herself" across Airbnb, VRBO, Booking.com, Expedia, SMS, WhatsApp, and email, handles late checkout requests, updates the reservation, issues keycodes, and creates housekeeping and maintenance tasks. Skills let you walk it through a procedure that it then runs the same way every time. AI Voice sits on the Max tier of its[pricing page](https://www.akia.com/pricing) , which lists no rates. Akia also sells a[vacation rental product](https://www.akia.com/solutions/vacation-rentals) that syncs with Escapia, Guesty, Streamline, Hostaway, OwnerRez, and Hostfully, although most of its published case studies are hotels. Our[Conduit vs Akia](https://www.conduit.ai/alternatives/akia) page compares the two directly.


### 2. Conduit (5 of 5)


Conduit's case rests on how far you can configure its agents and what they can reach. Each agent has its own instructions, model, guardrails, and a per-tool allowlist on every connection, can call sub-agents, runs in Autopilot or Copilot mode, and can be set differently per channel. Skills are named, versioned instruction packs attached to an agent. Deterministic workflows (conditions, filters, waits, send message, create task, run tool, HTTP request) can be called by an agent as a tool, and AI steps can sit inside a workflow, so you decide which parts follow fixed rules and which use judgment.


Agents get deep tools into Guesty, Hostaway, Streamline, Mews, and Breezeway (around 49 Breezeway tools, tasks included), and triggers start them from third-party events: a new or modified PMS reservation, a time offset before check-in or check-out, a task status change, a missed call, an inbound webhook, or a cron schedule. Workflows run on a durable runtime with retries, and an agent can schedule its own follow-up. Conduit has handled 50M+ conversations, automation typically runs at 70-90%, and[Cash Flow Street](https://www.conduit.ai/customers/cash-flow-street) reached 96% across 35 properties. Pricing is $18 to $48 per unit per month. The trade-off is setup time, since every one of those settings is yours to configure.


### 3. Besty AI (4 of 5)


Besty pairs a confidence-gated autopilot with voice and operations.[Autopilot Messaging](https://www.getbesty.ai/features/autopilot-messaging) sends only when it's confident and pauses when a guest's sentiment turns negative. Besty publishes an[AI Voice Receptionist](https://www.getbesty.ai/features/ai-voice-receptionist) labelled Beta, built-in VoIP, a workflow and SOP builder, and a[Cleaning & Ops](https://www.getbesty.ai/features/cleaning-ops) module with a field app. The[integrations page](https://www.getbesty.ai/integrations) lists 16 PMSs. Besty does not publish PMS write-back details or pricing.


### 4. Aeve (3 of 5)


Aeve is policy enforcement for Guesty and Hostaway hosts. Its product, Eve, answers within the rules you set and hands refunds, complaints, and anything that needs judgement to your team with the whole conversation attached.[Aeve says](https://www.aeve.ai/) operators reach 70 to 90 percent on autopilot, that it writes changes back to Guesty, and that a Guesty account can handle live messages within 24 hours.[Pricing](https://www.aeve.ai/pricing) is $12.80 per listing per month on a 12-month contract. No phone product is published. See our Aeve alternatives.


### 5. Hospitable (3 of 5)


Hospitable is a PMS with AI messaging that focuses on tone and timing across Airbnb, Vrbo, Booking.com, and Agoda. Its[pricing page](https://hospitable.com/pricing) lists four plans, and its AI features are AI Suggested Replies, Q&A Auto Replies, Message AI Assistant, Inbox AI (fully automated messaging on the Mogul plan), AI Issue Alerts, and AI Copilot.[Hospitable Tasks](https://hospitable.com/features/hospitable-tasks) creates tasks from check-in, check-out, and mid-stay events. It offers a 14-day free trial, and no phone product is listed. Our[Hospitable review](https://www.conduit.ai/blog/hospitable-review-pricing-alternatives) covers the plans.


### 6. Duve (2 of 5)


Duve leads with the guest app and adds AI on top.[DuveAI](https://duve.com/duve-ai/) answers in 100+ languages across WhatsApp, SMS, email, in-app chat, Airbnb, and Booking.com, escalates billing and anything it can't answer to staff, and Duve reports Edgar Suites at 80%. Service requests go to ops tools such as Flexkeeping, ALICE, and HotSOS rather than a task module of its own. The[pricing page](https://duve.com/pricing/) starts at a $120 monthly minimum. Duve lists no voice product. Our[Conduit vs Duve](https://www.conduit.ai/alternatives/duve) page covers the trade-off.


### 7. Enso Connect (2 of 5)


Enso Connect calls itself[the AI agent layer for Guesty](https://ensoconnect.com/integrations) and lists two-way sync with Hostaway. EnsoAI runs in Copilot or Autopilot mode in an inbox covering Airbnb, Booking.com, WhatsApp, SMS, email, and phone, Custom Workflows fire on guest events without code, and the Boarding Pass guest app handles verification and upsells. Enso[says it runs on 60,000+ properties](https://ensoconnect.com/) , with case studies at 65% to 75% automation. Pricing is not published.


### 8. HostBuddy AI (2 of 5)


HostBuddy is the cautious autopilot. It connects to 14 PMSs listed in its[FAQ](https://www.hostbuddy.ai/faqs) , can be scheduled to cover only off-hours, and raises[Action Items](https://www.hostbuddy.ai/action-items) for lockouts, maintenance, and anything needing approval.[HostBuddy says](https://www.hostbuddy.ai/) its top hosts see 95%+ AI automation rates. Its Journeys builder handles trigger, condition, and action workflows, but there's no task module or voice product. See our[HostBuddy alternatives](https://www.conduit.ai/blog/best-hostbuddy-alternatives) .


## How does an AI agent handle a late checkout request?


A late checkout request is the cleanest test of AI guest messaging software for short-term rentals, because the right answer depends on the next reservation and the cleaning schedule. The walkthrough below runs the request in Conduit for a host on Hostaway with cleaning in Breezeway, using tools that exist today.


At 8:40pm a guest on Airbnb asks to leave at 1pm instead of 11am. The agent's late-checkout skill holds the house policy, say 1pm when nobody arrives that day and noon at most on a same-day turnover. The agent calls a "late checkout check" workflow as a tool. The workflow runs Hostaway's search-reservations for the unit's next arrival and Breezeway's list_tasks for the cleaning scheduled that day, then branches on fixed conditions. It finds a guest arriving at 4pm and a clean booked for 11:30, so the same-day rule applies.


The agent offers noon, and the guest accepts. It calls Hostaway's update-reservation to set the new checkout time, moves the Breezeway task's scheduled time with update_task, and adds a comment for the cleaner. Then it schedules its own follow-up for 11:45 the next morning to remind the guest. If the incoming reservation changes overnight, a reservation-modified trigger re-runs the same workflow and escalates any conflict to your team.


Akia says its agent handles late checkout requests, and Aeve[sells late check-outs as an upsell](https://www.aeve.ai/) , so ask each vendor to run this exact flow on your PMS and your cleaning tool before you sign.

## How much does AI guest messaging software cost for short-term rentals?


AI guest messaging software for short-term rentals ranges from $12.80 per listing per month for Aeve on a 12-month contract (a flat $192 a month for up to 15 listings) to Conduit's $18 to $48 per unit per month. Conduit's packages are Messaging at $18 (voice AI included), Guest at $30, Guest + Devices at $36, and Full Suite at $48 with tasks and dispatch, plus a Startup plan at $899 a month for 0-25 units; those are starting rates, and pricing scales beyond 50 listings. Duve starts at a $120 monthly minimum. Hospitable has a free Essentials plan, HostBuddy prices by property count, and Akia, Besty, and Enso Connect quote on request.


For a host with a handful of listings and no phone volume, Hospitable's free tier, HostBuddy, or Aeve will cost less than Conduit. Conduit earns its price when requests like the late checkout above, calls, and cleaning changes are eating staff hours across a portfolio.


## FAQ


The questions below cover what short-term rental hosts ask most when choosing AI guest messaging software, including which tools answer calls, which change reservations in the PMS, what each costs, and how an AI agent differs from an AI reply tool. Each answer stands on its own.


### What is the best AI guest messaging software for short-term rentals?


The best AI guest messaging software for short-term rentals depends on how much work you want the AI to finish. Akia and Conduit answer messages and calls and act in the PMS, Besty adds a cautious autopilot with an operations module, Aeve enforces policies on Guesty or Hostaway, and Hospitable builds the AI into its own PMS.


### Which AI guest messaging tools answer phone calls?


Akia and Conduit publish AI that answers guest phone calls, and Besty publishes an AI Voice Receptionist labelled Beta. Hospitable, HostBuddy, Aeve, Duve, and Enso Connect do not publish an AI voice agent as of October 2026.


### Can AI guest messaging software change a reservation in the PMS?


Some AI guest messaging tools can change a reservation in the PMS. Akia says its agent updates reservations and issues keycodes, Aeve writes changes back to Guesty, and Conduit agents call PMS tools such as Hostaway's update-reservation when the tool is on that agent's allowlist.


### How much does AI guest messaging software cost for short-term rentals?


AI guest messaging software for short-term rentals costs from $12.80 per listing per month (Aeve, 12-month contract) to $18-$48 per unit per month (Conduit), with Duve from a $120 monthly minimum. Akia, Besty, and Enso Connect do not publish prices, Hospitable's paid figures did not render, and HostBuddy uses a property-count calculator.


### What is the difference between an AI reply tool and an AI agent for vacation rentals?


An AI reply tool writes answers from your knowledge base, while an AI agent can also look things up and act in other systems, such as checking the next reservation, moving a cleaning task, or updating checkout time. The test is whether the tool finishes the request or hands it to a person.


### Can an AI agent send a guest a message when the unit is ready?


Conduit has no built-in "unit ready" message, but you can build one with a cleaning-status trigger plus an agent or workflow. That trigger is available for Guesty and Calry-connected PMSs.
